scope: G14 candidate discovery only; G17-G20 out of scope

review.method: PyMuPDF text comparison localized a prose difference; relevant physical page 49 of each original PDF was rendered at 2x and visually compared. 3GPP ChangeRequests official index and V19.5.0 Annex B were checked for CR 0043.
review.coordinate: Both PDFs: physical page 49, printed page 48, clause 7.5 Step 7, equations (7.5-19) and (7.5-20); V19.5.0 Annex B: physical page 166
review.observedDifference: The ZOD offset table reference changes from 7.5-6/7/8 to 7.5-7/8/9/10/11/12. The later version also names 7.5-7/8/9/10/11/12 as the source of the mean of the ZSD log-normal distribution. The visible equation forms appear unchanged.
review.changeRecord: 3GPP 38.901 CR 0043, category F, impacted V19.4.0, approved for V19.5.0, titled Correction on ZOD generation in channel model
review.negativeControl: ISAC clause 7.9.5.5 Step 2 N=360, M=1 and Step 3 G=-25 dB appear in both versions, so the existing ISAC constant draft cannot be labelled a V19.5.0 revision case.
